description: Search Texas Administrative Code rules by topic within one chapter: matches the words against rule headings and, with full_text true, against the exact phrase inside rule text. Pass title and chapter (the Code has no keyless site-wide search; use tx_admin_toc to find the chapter). e.g. title "16", chapter "26", query "universal service fund" returns the rules 26.401 to 26.420. A query that matches nothing answers found:false with what was scanned.

full_text.description: Also search inside rule text for the exact phrase (reads up to 40 rules). Default false.

query.description: Words from a rule heading, or with full_text true an exact phrase from the rule text.

subchapter.description: Optional subchapter letter to narrow the scan, e.g. "P". Makes full_text cover every rule in it.

name: tx_admin_search
title: Tx Admin Search
